subject: Local pilot handoff — tool-calling + embeddings quickstart
messages:
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
To: Samantha Lee <samantha.lee@novus.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 2 Nov 2027 13:14:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Discovery recap & next steps — local pilot for tool-calling + embeddings

Hi Samantha —

Thanks again for taking the call this morning. Quick recap of what we agreed and proposed next steps so everyone has the same view: 

What we learned
- Primary goal: add a deterministic reranker + tool-calling flow to Novus Search so queries that map to workflows trigger actions (create record, fetch report).
- Target SLA: P95 generation latency <= 250ms for short prompts (50–100 tokens) in US region.
- Data residency: pilot can use hosted API, long-term may opt for Private deployment.

Proposed pilot scope (agreed on call)
1) Developer quickstart: Python + TypeScript sample apps that demonstrate
   - auth (API key + opt-in SSO flow)
   - routing (dev -> staging -> fallback hosted)
   - structured tool-calling example (calendar create + DB lookup)
   - embeddings + local reranker sample for result re-ranking
2) Local run instructions for Novus devs to test end-to-end without infra changes
3) A 60–90 minute technical pairing to validate auth and tool interfaces

Immediate asks / next steps
- Novus: confirm technical pairing attendees (Samantha + Eng lead) and preferred times next week.
- Redwood (me + Marissa + Aditya): deliver quickstart scaffold (Python/TS), an integration checklist, and a short demo script.

Attachments I uploaded to the shared Drive and included as stubs below: redwood-sample-scaffold.zip (scaffold + README), integration-checklist.pdf. Repo starter: https://github.com/redwood-inference/quickstarts/novus-toolcalling

Proposed slots for pairing (PST):
- Wed 2027-11-03 10:00–11:00
- Thu 2027-11-04 14:00–15:00

If those don't work, tell me a couple that do and we will accommodate.

Thanks — looking forward to getting you a runnable dev experience quickly.

Best,
Ben Carter
Enterprise Account Executive
Redwood Inference

---
Attachment stubs: redwood-sample-scaffold.zip (zip), integration-checklist.pdf (pdf)

From: Samantha Lee <samantha.lee@novus.ai>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Cc: Alex Johnson <alex.johnson@novus.ai>
Date: Tue, 2 Nov 2027 14:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Discovery recap & next steps — local pilot for tool-calling + embeddings

Ben — thanks for the clear recap. Confirming Novus can run the quickstart locally (that was the ask from the engineering exec). A few clarifications from our side before pairing: 

1) Auth: we want to validate API key flow first, then try SSO for staging. Can you share the SSO guidance and what parts require Private vs Hosted?
2) Tool calling: our calendar + analyst-run report workflow expects a JSON-first structured response so we can map actions reliably. Can the TS sample include schema validation examples?
3) Embeddings/reranker: we will bring a small corpus (5k docs) and want to sanity-check latency with quantized weights. Are there recommended quant profiles for cost/latency tradeoffs?

Attendees for pairing: Samantha (PM), Alex Johnson (Eng lead), plus two backend engineers (TBD). Preferred slot: Thu 2027-11-04 14:00–15:00 PST. That works for us.

Also, please add any required compliance notes (SOC2 audit pointers) to the Drive folder.

Thanks — Sam
Samantha Lee
Head of Platform Integrations
Novus.ai

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.com>
Cc: Samantha Lee <samantha.lee@novus.ai>, Alex Johnson <alex.johnson@novus.ai>
Date: Tue, 2 Nov 2027 15:30:00 -0700
Subject: Fwd: Discovery recap & next steps — local pilot for tool-calling + embeddings

Marissa / Aditya — forwarding Novus thread. They confirmed Thu 11/4 14:00 PST for the pairing. High priority pilot; key asks below. Can you own the quickstart deliverables and call prep?

Pilot deliverables (owner suggestions):
- Quickstart scaffold (Python + TypeScript) with step-by-step local run: owner Marissa. Deliver by EOD Wed 11/3 so we can iterate before pairing. Include: README, env example (.env.example), docker-compose for local mock services. Attach: redwood-sample-scaffold.zip stub.
- Auth doc: sample API key env, brief SSO notes + what requires Private: owner Aditya. Deliver by Tue 11/3 COB.
- Tool-calling sample: a TS function calling a mock calendar + a Python example that consumes structured JSON and validates schema: owner Marissa.
- Embeddings + reranker example: small script to index 5k docs, run a rerank pass and report latency/ops: owner Aditya. Include recommended quant profiles (int8 / int4) with perf notes.

Ask: keep the sample app minimal — focus on reproducible local tests so Novus engineers can run without provisioning cloud infra. Use local KV cache mocks and local embedding index (faiss or similar).

I'll own the pairing invite and provide an agenda (15m goals + 30m live debug + 15m next steps). Also add a short compliance note on where SOC2 evidence lives.

If this timeline is tight, call it out now and we'll push pairing by a few days.

Ben

---
Attachments stubs included: redwood-sample-scaffold.zip, integration-checklist.pdf

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.com>
Cc: Samantha Lee <samantha.lee@novus.ai>, Alex Johnson <alex.johnson@novus.ai>
Date: Tue, 2 Nov 2027 18:47:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Fwd: Discovery recap & next steps — local pilot for tool-calling + embeddings

All — I'll take the quickstart scaffold and tool-calling sample. Aditya, if you can take embeddings + quant profiles, we can split work and hit Ben's EOD Wed target. Quick notes on implementation approach: 

- Python quickstart: small Flask app + local worker that demonstrates tokenized calls, shows structured JSON output, and runs a mock "calendar" RPC to simulate tool-calling. README will include: env var examples, how to use an API key vs local dev stub for SSO (note: full SSO requires staging with Azure AD; we'll detail steps but not implement).
- TypeScript sample: Node + express sample that uses the Redwood JS SDK, includes schema validation with Zod and shows tool invocation pattern (tool metadata + call).
- Local testing: include a script `run_local_demo.sh` that spins up local mocks, loads a 5k doc subset into a simple FAISS index (python), and runs a reranking pass. We'll log token counts and P95 latency.

I will create a draft branch `novus/quickstart-nov2027` and push the scaffold this evening. Aditya, ping me if you need sample corpora or guidance on quant profiles — I have perf numbers from our last internal eval.

Marissa Cole
Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference

---
Commit tracking: branch novus/quickstart-nov2027 (will push PR with README and demo scripts).
